text.text_excerpt: Que rico! SO happy that they relocated from Slidell to Magazine street!! We arrived at 6pm for dinner on a Saturday to see that they had a "Closed" sign on the door. An employee came out and informed us that even though they had made double the food, they ran out of everything by 4pm and were going to reopen at 6:30pm. SO glad we waited!! We had the Havana sampler (pretty much a sampling of all of their appetizers), lechón asada, and ropa vieja. Everything was fantastic and rivales that to what I had had when visiting Cuba. The entrees come with plantains, rice, and incredibly flavorful black beans. Pro Tip: they are currently BYOB, so next time we will be back with some rum for Cuba Libr...

Que Rico! Cuban Cafe is fantastic! This is a small place on Magazine Street but the food definitely packs a punch. As someone who is Puerto Rican I can easily spot great latin food and Que rico passed all my flavor tests. My lady and I went at about 5:30 on a rainy Tuesday, the service was superb as we we're the only patrons in the restaurant. I ordered the classic ropa vieja and my lady ordered the shrimp, both meals were great. Side note: the tostones were better than the platano maduro, although they both were good. Overall, I think this addition was needed to the New Orleans food scene, you can only have smothered catfish and shrimp po'boys so many times before you're sick of it, lol....

I had a delicious Cuban dinner last night. The food was fresh, flavorful and filling. We did take out due to the COVID-19 restrictions but the cafe looks like it would be a nice cozy place to have dinner. Once this is all said and done I would definitely go back here to dine in. Before then, I'll continue to get it to go. It was that good. Let me just say I wanted EVERYTHING on the menu but instead settled for the chuletas, yuca con chicharron and tamal cerdo. It was a nice portion of food since we got the platters. They came with black beans, rice and platanos. I was so full and satisfied but could've easily eaten more. I can't wait until they open another restaurant in Slidell.
